summary: The Weeknd (Abel Tesfaye) emerged with anonymous mixtapes of dark, druggy R&B and became a global pop star with 1980s-styled hits like 'Blinding Lights'.
know: He released three mixtapes in 2011, starting with House of Balloons.
'Blinding Lights' spent over a year in the Billboard Hot 100's top 10.
He headlined the Super Bowl halftime show in 2021.

influencedBy.why: The Weeknd has named Michael Jackson as his main vocal influence and covered 'Dirty Diana'.
'House of Balloons' is built on a credited sample of Siouxsie and the Banshees' 'Happy House'.
His falsetto and dark sensuality draw on Prince.
He has cited Aaliyah, and his early moody R&B follows her sound.

cousins.why: Dark, seductive synth music about desire and excess.
Neon-lit 1980s-inspired anthems.

summary: SZA is a Top Dawg Entertainment singer whose conversational, diary-like R&B on Ctrl and SOS made her one of the most popular voices of her generation.
know: She was the first woman signed to Top Dawg Entertainment.
SOS (2022) spent 10 nonconsecutive weeks at No. 1.
She studied marine biology before dropping out to pursue music.

influencedBy.why: SZA has named Lauryn Hill as a major influence on her singing and songwriting.
She has cited Björk as an influence on her experimental approach.
Her loose, jazzy neo-soul phrasing follows Erykah Badu.

cousins.why: Diary-like, funny and wounded songwriting.
Her label mate, making personal, genre-blending records.

summary: Anderson .Paak is a drummer, singer and rapper whose funk- and soul-steeped albums and his Silk Sonic duo with Bruno Mars made him one of the most versatile performers in modern R&B.
know: He sings and raps from behind the drum kit with his band, the Free Nationals.
His breakthrough came with six guest spots on Dr. Dre's Compton (2015).
As Silk Sonic, he and Bruno Mars won Record and Song of the Year for 'Leave the Door Open'.

influencedBy.why: Dre signed him to Aftermath and mentored him after featuring him on Compton.
His loose, swinging drum feel draws on Dilla's beats.
His 1970s-style soul songwriting follows Stevie Wonder.

cousins.why: A live band that blurs hip-hop, funk and soul.

summary: Leon Bridges is a Fort Worth singer whose debut Coming Home closely recreated the sound of early-1960s soul before he branched into more modern R&B.
know: He was washing dishes when he began writing his first songs.
Coming Home (2015) was nominated for the Grammy for Best R&B Album.
He made two EPs with the Texas band Khruangbin.

influencedBy.why: Bridges has named Sam Cooke as his biggest influence and model for Coming Home.
His early-1960s Southern soul sound draws on Otis Redding.

cousins.why: A Southern singer with a warm, old-school voice.

summary: Solange Knowles moved from Motown-style pop to experimental R&B, and A Seat at the Table became a widely praised statement on Black identity.
know: She toured with Destiny's Child as a backup dancer as a teenager.
'Cranes in the Sky' won the Grammy for Best R&B Performance.
A Seat at the Table (2016) was her first No. 1 album.
